kokoro-82m.description: Built-in local voice for the assistant. No download needed.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base

moonshine-medium-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Medium

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash

cohere-int8.name: Cohere

aiCorrection.label: AI cleanup (in development)
aiCorrection.description: Experimental: clean up your dictation with AI. Rough and unpolished — off by default.
aiCorrection.info: Runs a language model over your dictation to fix punctuation, remove filler words, and optionally adjust the tone. Applies to dictation only (not the assistant chat) and runs on its own shortcut. It adds a delay since the model runs after transcription; if it fails or times out, your raw text is pasted instead. Uses your assistant's model by default. This feature is still in development — you can't yet pick a built-in local model from its own list, and it needs more tuning before it's a main feature.

postProcessTimeout.title: AI cleanup timeout
postProcessTimeout.description: How long to wait for the model before giving up and pasting your raw transcription instead. On the built-in local model, allow enough time for it to load on first use.

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental features
experimentalToggle.description: Reveal in-development features. Off by default.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep mic open between transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Faster back-to-back dictation. May affect Bluetooth audio quality.

liveTranscription.label: Live transcription
liveTranscription.description: Transcribe speech as you talk, instead of all at once when you stop. Experimental.

closeBehavior.label: Quit when I close the window
closeBehavior.description: When off, closing the window keeps SpeakoFlow running in the tray so your hotkeys still work. When on, closing the window quits the app completely.

overlayStyle.title: Overlay
overlayStyle.description: How the recording overlay looks while you dictate. None hides it, Minimal is the compact pill, and Live shows a readable card with your words as you speak (for models that support it).

overlayLinger.title: Keep finished text on screen
overlayLinger.description: How long the Live card stays up after you finish dictating, so you can read or copy what was typed. Hovering over the card keeps it open.

noVerbatim.description: Drops "um", "uh", false starts, and repeats. Turn this off to get back exactly what you said, word for word.

language.description: The language you speak. Every provider here answers in that same language — telling it up front improves accuracy, and Auto lets it detect the language itself.

model.emptyDescription: SpeakoFlow Mini is a small download built for this.

catalog.title: Choose your cleanup model

aiCleanup.tunedModelNotice: This model is fine-tuned for English dictation cleanup, so it works best on the recommended prompt with no style.
aiCleanup.title: Fix up my dictation with AI
aiCleanup.caption: Experimental — tidies punctuation and filler after you dictate.
aiCleanup.info: Cleanup rewrites what you said with an AI model before it's typed. It can take a moment and falls back to your raw words if it's slow.

spokenEmoji.title: Spoken emoji

flow.phraseDescription: Flow activates only when a dictation begins with this phrase. Anywhere else, the same words paste as normal dictation. Uses your assistant's model; leave empty to reset to “Hey Flow”.
flow.screenDescription: Let Flow take one screenshot when a command clearly refers to your screen, like “look at this email and draft a reply”. The model decides if it's needed. Separate from the assistant's screen access.

characters.title: Profiles

characters.greetingPlaceholder: Optional opening line shown in an empty chat

memory.label: Conversation memory

responseLength.label: Response length
responseLength.description: Preferred reply length. "No effect" leaves your prompt untouched.

screenRecording.description: Screen vision needs macOS Screen Recording permission. Grant it in System Settings, then restart SpeakoFlow for it to take effect.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.enableDescription: Let the assistant search the web when a question needs current information.
webSearch.openRouterNativeDescription: When on, OpenRouter runs the search itself (its :online mode) using your OpenRouter credits. When off, the app searches with your search provider below.
webSearch.providerDescription: Serper is a good default. Every provider has a free tier, and TinyFish is free with no card.
webSearch.apiKeyDescription: Key for the selected search provider.
webSearch.fetchContentDescription: Read the full text of each result instead of snippets. Better answers, but slower.
webSearch.depthDescription: Quick for simple facts, Standard for most questions, Deep for hard ones.
webSearch.localSmartDescription: Let the local model decide when to search. Off uses a fast keyword check instead.
webSearch.creditBudgetDescription: Daily cap on Firecrawl credits before search pauses. 0 = no limit.
webSearch.testDescription: Run a sample search with the current provider and key.

tts.title: Voice output
tts.enableDescription: Read replies out loud while you're in a live conversation. Quick text answers are never spoken.
tts.stopOnDictationDescription: Stop any reply that's still playing when you start dictating.
tts.engineDescription: Voices on this computer are free and private, and work without the internet. Cloud voices use an API key from that provider. Custom connects to a speech server you run yourself.
tts.sectionLocalHint: Free and private. Runs on this computer and works offline.
tts.sectionCloudHint: Needs an API key from the provider. Custom connects to a speech server you run yourself.
tts.kokoroSetupDescription: Download it once, then spoken replies run privately on this device.

runsOnStatus.checking: Uses the graphics card when it works, and the processor when it doesn't.
runsOnStatus.gpuUnusable: Speaking on the processor, because the graphics card can't run the voice on this computer.
runsOnStatus.needsPack: The graphics card can't run the voice on this computer. Download the processor voice below for fast replies.
runsOnStatus.cpuNeedsPack: Download the processor voice below. Until then Kokoro runs inside the app, which is slow.
runsOnStatus.loadFailed: The processor voice couldn't start on this computer, so Kokoro runs inside the app for now.
runsOnStatus.noNativeSlow: The graphics card can't run the voice on this computer, so Kokoro runs slowly inside the app. A cloud voice would be faster.
runsOnStatus.gpuForcedUnusable: The graphics card can't run the voice properly on this computer. Set Runs on to Automatic or Processor.

tts.kokoroNativeDescription: Lets Kokoro speak fast on the processor when the graphics card can't. {{size}} download.
tts.kittenSizeDescription: All three sizes have the same eight voices. Bigger sizes sound more natural but take longer to start speaking, most of all on a small processor.

packDescription.kitten: A small voice that runs on the processor. {{size}} download.
packDescription.pocket: Kyutai's natural-sounding voice, made for processors, with 14 speakers. {{size}} download.
packDescription.supertonic: Supertone's fast, clear voice, with ten speakers. {{size}} download.

tts.kittenSuggestDescription: This computer has a small processor. Kitten is a lighter voice that replies faster here.
tts.dtypeDescription: Only for Kokoro running inside the app. fp32 is highest quality; q8 is smaller. Changing this reloads the model. If the voice sounds garbled, set Runs on to Processor.
tts.speedRange: {{engine}} supports {{min}}× to {{max}}×; other speeds use the nearest limit.
tts.speedUnsupported: {{engine}} always speaks at its natural speed.
tts.volumeDescription: How loud spoken replies are. Separate from the feedback sounds.
tts.expressivenessDescription: How much the voice's delivery varies, from steady and even to lively and emotional.
tts.expressivenessInfo: This is ElevenLabs' Stability setting, turned around. Until you move it, each voice uses its own saved setting. The far expressive end can sometimes sound uneven.
tts.audioTagsDescription: Let the voice perform its replies with cues like [laughs] and [whispers], and sound effects like [applause].
tts.audioTagsNeedsModel: Needs an Eleven v3 or v4 model, such as eleven_v4. Choose one under Model to turn this on.
tts.audioTagsInfo: The assistant writes short cues in square brackets into its spoken replies, and the ElevenLabs voice acts them out or plays them as sounds instead of reading them. Ask for a scene, like being cheered on by a crowd, and it builds one with effects. The chat shows the cues as written. Only ElevenLabs v3 and v4 voices perform them; every other voice has them removed before speaking.
tts.audioTagIntensityDescription: How often the voice reacts and adds effects, from a light touch to a full performance.
tts.testDescription: Play a short sample with the current settings.
tts.testFailed: Kokoro couldn't make the sample. Try again, or set Runs on to Processor.
tts.testGpuMoved: Your graphics card garbled the sample, so it was muted. Kokoro now uses the processor, so test again to hear it.
tts.testGpuForced: Your graphics card garbled the sample, so it was muted. Set Runs on to Automatic or Processor.
tts.testGpuSuspect: The sample came out garbled, so it was muted. Test again to check your graphics card.
tts.testPhrase: Hi! This is a test of SpeakoFlow's voice output.
tts.downloadError: Couldn't download the Kokoro voice model
tts.baseUrlDescription: Your speech server's OpenAI-compatible address, e.g. http://localhost:8880/v1. Works with Kokoro-FastAPI, Speaches, Chatterbox, Orpheus-FastAPI, LocalAI and other servers that offer /v1/audio/speech. A full /audio/speech URL also works.
tts.azureBaseUrlDescription: Your Azure Speech URL from the portal, e.g. https://eastus2.tts.speech.microsoft.com.
tts.apiKeyDescription: Your {{provider}} API key. Each voice engine keeps its own key.
tts.apiKeyOptionalDescription: Only needed if your server asks for one.
tts.modelDescription: The model that speaks. Leave it empty to use the engine's default, shown in grey.
tts.remoteVoiceDescription: Voice for OpenAI-compatible TTS, e.g. alloy, echo, nova, shimmer.
tts.azureVoiceDescription: Azure voice name, e.g. en-US-JennyNeural. Click Load voices to browse.
tts.voiceLoadDescription: Press Load voices to see this engine's voices, or type a voice ID.
tts.deepgramVoiceDescription: A Deepgram voice is also its model, e.g. aura-2-thalia-en. Press Load voices to browse.
tts.elevenVoiceDescription: ElevenLabs voice ID (from the Voices tab in their dashboard).
tts.promptDescription: Instructions for generating the brief spoken summary of each answer.

lengthHints.default: As long as the question needs.

panel.title: Floating panel
panel.description: How the panel looks and where it opens. The preview updates as you change it.
panel.positionHint: Click a spot on the screen. The shape is the shape it opens in: a tall column down a side, or a wide strip along the top or bottom. Drag the panel near a spot and it snaps there.

tips.thinksWith: The model that answers you. AI cleanup and meeting notes use it too when they have none of their own.
tips.speaks: Reads replies aloud during a conversation.
tips.screenAsk: Lets the assistant look when a question is about your screen, or when you ask it to. Questions about selected text are answered from the text. Screenshots go only to your AI provider.
tips.screenCall: Lets the assistant look during a conversation when you ask it to, or when you're talking about something on your screen.
tips.captureTiming: Grab the screen as it was when you started asking, or when you send.
tips.webSearch: Looks things up online when a question needs current facts.
tips.depth: Quick for simple facts, Deep for hard questions.
tips.openRouterSearch: Uses OpenRouter's own search and your OpenRouter credits.
tips.localSmart: Lets the on-device model decide when to search.
tips.reminders: Just ask: "Remind me to call Sam in 20 minutes." A note pops up when it's time.
tips.memory: Remembers what matters to you. Stored only on this computer.
tips.profiles: Personas with their own name, instructions, and reply style.
tips.history: How many recent messages it keeps in mind.
tips.summarize: Condenses long chats so it doesn't forget the start.
tips.opacity: Lower lets your desktop show through.
tips.position: Click a spot on the screen.
tips.display: The screen the panel opens on.

memory.aboutTip: A short summary it keeps in mind in every reply. It updates as you talk, and you can edit it any time.
memory.aboutEmpty: Nothing yet. It fills this in as you talk, or you can write it yourself.
memory.notesTip: Facts it picked up from your chats, plus anything you add. Each reply uses the ones that fit.
memory.notesEmpty: Nothing yet. It learns from your chats, or add something above.
memory.detailTip: Light uses only the summary. Detailed adds more notes and is a little slower.
memory.eraseBody_one: This deletes the summary and {{count}} note. It can't be undone.
memory.eraseBody_other: This deletes the summary and all {{count}} notes. It can't be undone.
memory.dialogDescription: What the assistant knows about you. It stays on this computer, and you can change or erase any of it.

profiles.newWithAi: Describe it and let AI write it
profiles.restoredNone: All built-in profiles are already here
profiles.roleTip: A few words shown under the name.
profiles.instructionsTip: How this profile thinks and talks. Sent with every message.
profiles.lengthTip: Default follows Reply length on the Assistant page.
profiles.greetingTip: Optional. Shown when a new chat starts.
profiles.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! What are we working on?
profiles.aiBody: Say or type what it should be like. The assistant writes its name and instructions.

hero.title: Every call, written down.

meetingsPage.transcribedByTip: Writes the transcript. It is your Speech to text model, the same one dictation uses.
meetingsPage.notesByTip: Writes the notes and the title, and answers questions about a meeting. It is your Assistant model.

historyPage.audioMissing: This recording's audio file is no longer available.
historyPage.recoverTitle: Transcribe it again and keep it
